about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/eval, the check-time evaluator (L7). Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/eval; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it. Seeded by unit EV1 (wf10 l7-eval, 2026-11-10).

mutants.name: short-circuit-rhs
mutants.rule: && and || evaluate their right operand only when the left one does not decide (lower/expr.go binary).

mutants.name: int8-constant-widened
mutants.rule: An int8 value wraps at 8 bits: non-constant arithmetic wraps at its type's width (types.md, Basic types 2).

mutants.name: int8-op-widened
mutants.rule: An int8 operation wraps at 8 bits and gives an int8 (types.md, Basic types 2).

mutants.name: defect-caught
mutants.rule: A catch handles typed failures only; a defect is never caught (rows.md, Catch 6).

mutants.name: divide-by-zero-ok
mutants.rule: An integer division by zero is a defect, as Go panics on it.

mutants.name: negative-shift-ok
mutants.rule: A shift by a negative count is a defect, as Go panics on it.

mutants.name: variant-test-true
mutants.from: return r.t.Obj == tt.Obj && r.key == argsKey(tt, t.env)
mutants.rule: A type pattern matches a union value only of that variant (rows.md, Totality; a Go type switch).

mutants.name: returned-error-is-value
mutants.rule: Returning a value of an error type is a failure (types.md, Error types 2).

mutants.name: absent-fact-pure
mutants.rule: An absent footprint is not an empty one (rows.md, Footprints 2): an internal error, never a pure frame.

mutants.name: defect-continues
mutants.rule: A defect stops the run (runtime.md, Tests 3).

mutants.name: incomplete-continues
mutants.rule: The budget is per request: once it runs out, every later obligation is reported not run (L7 plan, section 5).

mutants.name: fuel-ignored
mutants.rule: Every evaluated node costs steps before its work, so a loop that never ends exhausts the budget (L7 plan, section 5).

mutants.name: skip-as-pass
mutants.from: res.Status, res.Reason = Skipped, "a law takes generated cases
mutants.to: res.Status, res.Reason = Passed, "a law takes generated cases
mutants.rule: A skipped law is never a pass (runtime.md, Tests 7; L7 plan, section 5).

mutants.name: slice-write-shared
mutants.rule: A write through one binding never changes another binding's slice or array (Bindings 1).

mutants.name: map-write-shared
mutants.rule: A Map's index write, Put and Delete change only their root (Bindings 1).

mutants.name: append-tip-owned
mutants.rule: An Append that shares its input must not grant exclusive ownership to its output (Bindings 1).

mutants.name: handover-lends-not
mutants.rule: A read that lets a part escape revokes the slot's exclusive ownership (Bindings 1).

mutants.name: record-field-shared
mutants.from: next := &record{t: c.t, key: c.key, fields: append([]Value(nil), c.fields...)}
mutants.rule: A record field write changes that root alone (Bindings 1).

mutants.name: range-snapshot-domain
mutants.to: if false && r.root == root && r.view.b == old {
mutants.rule: Slice range sees indexed writes through its root (Bindings 3; Loops and len 7); seed-83 bug.

mutants.name: int8-conversion-dropped
mutants.to: if b.Kind == check.Int8 { return int8(0), nil }; out, ok := convertBasic(v, b.Kind)
mutants.rule: Runtime conversion to int8 preserves its low eight bits (Conversions).

mutants.name: literal-frame-copies
mutants.from: callee := &frame{pkg: fr.pkg, info: fr.info, decl: fr.decl, vars: fr.vars, env: fr.env, owner: fr.owner}
mutants.to: vars := map[*check.Var]*slot{}; for k, v := range fr.vars { vars[k] = &slot{v: v.v} }; callee := &frame{pkg: fr.pkg, info: fr.info, decl: fr.decl, vars: vars, env: fr.env, owner: fr.owner}
mutants.rule: An immediately called literal writes its enclosing mutable locals (Function values 2).

mutants.name: init-order-ignored
mutants.to: for i := len(p.Info.InitOrder)-1; i >= 0; i-- { ini := p.Info.InitOrder[i]
mutants.rule: Every package initializer runs in the checker's dependency order before obligations.

mutants.name: string-range-bytes
mutants.to: for i := range len(dom.(string)) { r := rune(dom.(string)[i])
mutants.rule: String range decodes UTF-8 runes, including invalid bytes, as Go does (Loops and len 1).

mutants.name: copy-fuel-ignored
mutants.from: if ab := in.charge(fr, at, int64(s.n)+1); ab != nil {
mutants.to: if ab := in.charge(fr, at, 0); ab != nil {
mutants.rule: Bulk copying consumes element work before allocation (plan section 5).

mutants.name: recursion-depth-ignored
mutants.rule: The explicit call-depth bound stops recursion with incomplete, never pass.

mutants.name: generic-substitution-unbound
mutants.rule: A generic call's checked arguments bind the callee's type parameters, including nominal patterns (Generics).
